name: The Bathwater
description: A bathroom, running, steam on everything, the mirror gone white with it. The water is exactly the right temperature and there is far too much of it. It has been running a while. It is not overflowing, and that is the part that is wrong.

objects.name: the mirror
looks: Fogged. There is a handprint on it from this side.
Someone has written in it, and it faded, and it is coming back.
You wipe it clear. The room in it is dry.

objects.name: the water
looks: Perfectly clear, and it goes down further than the building does.
Something turns over in it, slowly, the way a sleeper does.

ambient: The tap runs and the level does not change.
An extractor fan starts up in a bathroom that has never had one.
Steam moves aside briefly, as if for someone.
weather: The steam does not rise. It stands, at chest height, and waits.
